2) Despite the best efforts of your loved ones, you have decided to pursue a Ph.D. on the consequences of founder effects (population bottlenecks associated with colonization of new environments) in three-spined stickleback. Assume lateral plate number is under simple genetic control, with dominant homozygotes having 3 plates, heterozygotes 7 plates, and recessive homozygotes 8 plates; assume also $f(A_1)=0.1$, where $A_1$ is the dominant allele. Calculate the expected population-wide mean plate number in an outcrossed population ($M_O$) and an inbred population ($M_F$) if $F=0.1$. (Remember that $a$, $d$, and $-a$ are deviations from a midpoint and must be rescaled to get actual trait values.)
